proposedImplementation.change: Define strict project.update payload {project:Rox2EntityRef,name?:string} and RoxCommand v2 envelope with required idempotencyKey/expectedRevision/workspaceId, schemaVersion and correlation metadata; reject unknown payload/body actor fields and workspace/entity-kind mismatches. Define durable receipt/wire result and typed injected command/repository/policy ports using existing Rox2EntityRef/Rox2Status. No service I/O in core; no second registry.

Implement transport-independent project.update against injected authenticated actor. Validate and authorize before exposing receipts/results. Compute immutable canonical semantic request hash including operation/workspace/project/expectedRevision/name; transport retry metadata must not change semantic hash. In one transaction serialize (workspace,actor,key), replay matching committed receipt BEFORE fresh CAS, reject hash mismatch, check current resource policy/revoke fence, apply required expectedRevision CAS, persist resulting Project/registry revision, entity.updated and project.updated events, outbox rows and final receipt. Return only after durable commit; duplicate concurrent retries must converge to the same committed result.

Implement transaction port using accepted dependency Project/entity/policy repositories, not another Project store. Store immutable receipt response/revision/timestamp/event IDs; unique actor-scoped idempotency tuple; atomic CAS+events+receipt+outbox. Lease outbox deliveries durably with expiry/retry/DLQ accounting; do not mark claimed as processed. consumer_inbox UNIQUE(consumer_id,event_id) and actual projection effect/watermark commit together; fence stale aggregate revisions, policy epochs and tombstones. Resume outstanding leases after crash; cursor is persisted and authorization-scoped.

Add command_receipt/domain_event/outbox/consumer_inbox, typed receipt/job keys, workspace UUIDs, scoped entity FKs, schema_version>0, revision>=0, timestamps, unique (workspace_id,actor_principal_id,idempotency_key), immutable request_hash guard, unique (consumer_id,event_id), lease/processed separation and pending/cursor indexes. Reuse dependency alias table/unique keys and Project/entity revision, not duplicate alias/project tables. Backfill accepted canonical identity/provenance; quarantine ambiguity. Before cutover rollback uses verified snapshot/writer route; after accepted writes forward repair or verified reverse replay, never delete new writes.

Real service/DB scenarios with seed 20260934, W1, A owner/B member/C outsider and PRIVATE_WP-04: process kill after commit before reply and exact retry receipt/revision/event identity; stale revision HTTP 409; altered payload same key rejection; concurrent duplicate key and actor/workspace key isolation; duplicate/reordered event delivery and consumer crash after effect before ACK; actor/workspace/ref forgery and revoke/allow-all denial; rollback/no premature ACK. ACK-before-commit seeded control must specifically fail data-survival oracle, with independent second holdout control. UI/native/HTTP/API readback and projection receipts remain distinct from fixture preparation.

Then rehash/rebind changed source at that committed revision, resolve shared command port/actor/writer-mode and strict DTO-to-triad contract requests, and implement normative contracts -> transaction repository/migration -> project.update command -> lead-owned native/HTTP/projection integration -> real crash/retry/CAS/hash/replay scenarios. This preflight itself is complete only as a report, not a feature.
risks: Legacy UPDATE, saveProjectConfig and uninspected agent/direct callers can bypass service; lead must inventory/migrate callers before shared cutover.
Rechecking CAS before finding an already committed matching receipt would incorrectly reject safe retry after post-commit reply loss.
Receipt replay after revoke can leak DTO/title unless current authorization is checked before returning persisted data; dedup does not override policy.
Concurrent same-key retry must be serialized by DB uniqueness/transaction semantics, not process-local map; receipt hash immutability must survive restart.
consumer_inbox inserted or marked processed before actual projection commit suppresses replay after crash; claimed lease is not processed receipt.
Two intended event types must not cause duplicate downstream effects; consumers need typed event identity/semantic dedup and revision fences.
Request schema preserves only name while native ProjectConfig patch supports many fields; narrowing shared behavior or falling back to files silently violates preservation/single authority.
Response schema string status and canonical triad conflict; pre-operation nativeLive receipt markers are not post-commit command verification.
Date.now updatedAt and local proj_<8-char> IDs cannot prove authoritative revision or canonical import continuity; use accepted aliases/provenance.
Optional name permits an identity-only payload; no-op revision/event policy is unspecified and must be resolved by contract owner, not rejected by invented required field.
Full checklist has downstream offline/search/attention dependencies; accepted producer implementation is not featureComplete and missing items cannot become N/A.
Making WP-51/WP-52 prerequisite packages for WP-04 creates a published DAG cycle; extract minimal accepted guards/runtime interfaces instead.
Working tree changes during integration can stale line/hash evidence; hashes here represent observed files only, input_revision is dispatch metadata.
No product checks were executed in this authorized read-only preflight; all proposed verification requires implementation owner and exact runtime revision evidence.
